prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 3 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1372; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision involving a side impact at an intersection. On initial evaluation, the patient reported pain and swelling over the left wrist and was unable to bear weight through the affected hand. Physical examination revealed tenderness over the distal radius, limited range of motion, and mild deformity. Radiographs confirmed a displaced distal radius fracture without intra-articular extension. Closed reduction was performed under local anesthesia, and the wrist was immobilized in a well-padded forearm cast.

At the second visit, the patient was reassessed for neurovascular status, which remained intact. Cast alignment was confirmed on repeat imaging, and the patient was counseled on elevation, finger mobilization, and avoidance of lifting with the affected arm. Pain was managed with oral analgesics as needed.

At the third visit, follow-up radiographs showed maintained alignment and early signs of callus formation. Given satisfactory progress, the plan includes continued immobilization for the remaining healing period, followed by referral to physical therapy for range-of-motion and strengthening exercises. The patient was advised to return sooner for numbness, color change, or increasing pain.
